description: Verify that TCP in CLOSED sends a SYN on an active OPEN call (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
The active-OPEN entry transition: from CLOSED, the user's OPEN call must produce a SYN on the wire and move the state to SYN-SENT.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in CLOSED.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: active OPEN call.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted SYN observed within the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted SYN on active OPEN — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN within listen window
